cx.doc: Ink blot center x, as a fraction of canvas width

cy.doc: Ink blot center y, as a fraction of canvas height

softness.doc: Edge feather width, as a fraction of the canvas short side; 0 = hard edge (recommended for hand-drawn footage)

roughness.doc: Rough edge amplitude: the radius varies by ±roughness (as a fraction) in each direction; 0 degenerates to transition.circleCrop

seed.doc: Seed for the rough-edge shape (rounded); the shape stays the same throughout the transition and only grows

invert.doc: true = ink blot **contracts**: starts from the canvas outer edge with the incoming frame and ends at the center

doc: A rough-edged blob of ink bleeds out from the center, and the incoming frame replaces the inside of the blot. Let d be the Euclidean distance from each pixel to the center (cx·W, cy·H), r = roughness, and n(dir) ∈ [0, 1] a two-octave 2D value noise sampled along the unit direction vector (lattice values come from splitmix64(seed, lattice index), using only add, subtract, multiply, divide and sqrt). u = d·(1 + r·(2n − 1)), U is the maximum of u over the whole frame (U − u when invert = true), and the rest is the same as transition.circleCrop: e = progress × (U + S + 1), cov = clamp((e − u) / S, 0, 1) (S = 0 gives cov = [u < e]). progress = 0 / 1 is byte-identical to from / to; the shape does not change with progress, so it does not “boil” mid-transition.
